mapper.select: SELECT pk_id, id, tenant_id, account_id, display_name, mobile, title, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted FROM staff_profile WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT pk_id, id, tenant_id, account_id, display_name, mobile, title, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted FROM staff_profile WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE staff_profile SET display_name = #{displayName}, mobile = #{mobile}, title = #{title}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.sql:
FROM staff_profile p INNER JOIN staff_account a ON a.id = p.account_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.is_deleted = 0
AND (p.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.status = #{status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM staff_role_binding r WHERE r.staff_id = p.id AND r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND r.is_deleted = 0 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM staff_org_binding o WHERE o.staff_id = p.id AND o.org_id = #{orgId} AND o.is_deleted = 0 )
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id AS staffId, p.account_id AS accountId, a.username, p.display_name AS displayName, p.mobile, p.title, a.status, p.gmt_created AS createdAt
ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
